recognition.summary: Hall eligibility covers accepted High/Critical reports or more than five new valid Medium/Low reports within 90 days; listing is discretionary.

reporting.summary: Reports go directly to the in-house security email from the reporter's registered address.

rewards.summary: Monetary awards follow separate review; payment for a lower-severity report does not itself confer Hall recognition.

limitations: Participation includes five-year confidentiality terms and other restrictions; publication and recognition should not be assumed from submission alone.
rights: Original summary CC BY 4.0; linked sources and trademarks retain their own rights.
